items.title: Define bounded functional SBRef associations
items.acceptance: Exact participant/session/directory and normalized acquisition entities; shared unindexed or complete indexed references, explicit ambiguity; document policy separately from BIDS validity.

items.title: Assess SBRef metadata and single-volume headers
items.acceptance: Bound header observations and relevant effective metadata origins; reject malformed rank or metadata without requiring BOLD timing semantics.

items.title: Retain exact SBRef relationship evidence
items.acceptance: Version semantic profile and graph; deterministic companion-selection evidence, ambiguity diagnostics and exact closure.

items.title: Include SBRef in functional subset views
items.acceptance: Retain bytes, flatten approved metadata, preserve fieldmap dependencies, roundtrip complete reference closure.

items.title: Curate BOLD and SBRef associations coherently
items.acceptance: Atomic image family moves/removal, preserve indexed/shared association, reject partial edits; metadata correction remains independent.

items.title: Declare calibrated functional readiness contracts
items.acceptance: Opt-in versioned requirements for optional/required reference and explicit EPI pair calibration, separate from existing processing algorithm.

items.title: Check calibration direction and readout metadata
items.acceptance: Require explicit source families, valid axis/sign and positive readout times; opposite directions under bounded same-grid policy.

items.title: Bind reference and calibration geometry evidence
items.acceptance: Opt-in complete payload and coded geometry on companions with exact pairwise image/metadata binding; matching declarations are not registration.

items.title: Report missing and ambiguous calibration clearly
items.acceptance: Deterministic readiness evidence and actionable missing/ambiguous/unsupported/disallowed requirements, no proximity guessing.

items.title: Retain licensed acquired reference/calibration fixtures
items.acceptance: Pin primary source, license, source hashes and honest bounded transformations; exercise actual BOLD/SBRef/EPI declarations.

items.title: Qualify malformed calibration boundaries
items.acceptance: Authored cases cover incomplete/mixed references, metadata, payload, geometry, evidence substitution, cross-session and family edits.

items.title: Compare validator and export re-import evidence
items.acceptance: Pinned official validator observations distinct from recipe policy; independent geometry/bytes and complete export re-import comparisons.

items.title: Freeze complete calibrated bundles on both catalogs
items.acceptance: One BOLD selects complete echo/reference/events/stimuli/declared fieldmap closure; private bundle source evidence immutable.

items.title: Execute existing recipes on qualified bundles
items.acceptance: Use existing temporal-statistics maps with exact input contract and bundle provenance; calibration companions do not change algorithm.

items.title: Qualify calibration publication history and authority
items.acceptance: Workspace-loss publication/retry; corrections preserve history; current source policy gates private access/new publication.

items.title: Retain executable calibration demonstration and full gate
items.acceptance: Run ordinary/PostgreSQL/crash/restore and isolated source checks; retain demo, independent numerical evidence and final source receipt.
